title: Zymo Quick DNA HMW Labelling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the [Zymo Quick-DNA HMW MagBead Kit](https://www.zymoresearch.com/products/quick-dna-hmw-magbead-kit) with an additional labelling step that takes place before the purification. The parameter section below gives you the ability to select either the **Labelling** portion of the protocol or the **Purification** portion of the protocol (you can select both). During the labelling portion, MilliQ Water, CSB, M.Taql, MTC22, and Proteinase K are added to the samples and the samples incubate while on the Temperature Module. During the purification portion, the samples are purified using the Zymo MagBead Kit in conjunction with Opentrons Magnetic Module. If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at [protocols@opentrons.com](mailto:protocols@opentrons.com). --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 4.0.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons Temperatue Module, GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/tempdeck) * [Opentrons Magnetic Module, GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/magdeck) * [Opentrons P20 8-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons P300 8-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 20µL Tip Racks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips) * [Opentrons 300µL Tip Racks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips) * [NEST 12-Well Reservoir, 15mL](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/nest-12-well-reservoir-15-ml) * [Bio-Rad 96-Well PCR
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect all required Opentrons hardware and labware: OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (Version 4.0.0 or later), Temperature Module GEN2, Magnetic Module GEN2, P20 8‑Channel Pipette, P300 8‑Channel Pipette, 20 µL tip racks, 300 µL tip racks, NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL), Bio‑Rad 96‑Well PCR plate, Zymo Quick‑DNA HMW MagBead Kit, MilliQ water, CSB, M.Taql, MTC22, and Proteinase K.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol file for the Zymo Quick‑DNA HMW Labelling Protocol from the provided source.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the protocol’s deck map, placing the temperature module, magnetic module, tip racks, reservoir, and PCR plate in the specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the tip racks, reservoir, and PCR plate for the P20 and P300 8‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Add labelling reagents and incubate
steps.instruction: Add MilliQ water, CSB, M.Taql, MTC22, and Proteinase K to each sample as specified by the kit, then place the plate on the Temperature Module for the required incubation.

substeps.instruction: Dispense MilliQ water into each well.
Add Proteinase K to each well.
Incubate the plate on the Temperature Module (temperature and time as defined by the kit).

steps.title: Purify DNA with MagBead kit
steps.instruction: Perform the Zymo Quick‑DNA HMW MagBead purification on the Magnetic Module according to the kit instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add MagBead binding solution to each well.
Allow DNA to bind to beads.
Engage the Magnetic Module to separate beads.
Perform wash steps as described in the kit.
Elute purified DNA from the beads.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated labelling and purification sequence.
